description: Creates a JSON Web Token (JWT) using the Dev Proxy jwt create command. Returns the generated token.

claims.description: Custom claims to include in the token in the format name:value

name.description: The name of the user to create the token for

roles.description: The roles to include in the token

scopes.description: The scopes to include in the token

signingKey.description: The signing key for the token. Must be at least 32 characters

name: CreateJwt
